oliver: saw 3 OOMs on api-prod-runtime-3 in the last 45m after the kernel-selector tweak. cudaMalloc failing then we keep retrying same kernel :thinking:

maria: can you dump allocator stats + last kernel choice? need soft_reserve, free_segments, fragmentation

oliver: grabbing now, pasting short dump:
```
workspace_reserved_mb: 3968
kv_cache_mb: 1240
free_segments: 32
fragmentation_pct: 27

```

raj: if memory-optimized-v2 is getting picked and still OOMing maybe its workspace accounting regressed. temporary mitigation: flip circuit breaker to fallback and route heavy requests to the 4-bit quantized model.

sre-oncall: enabling request-level circuit breaker now for api-prod-runtime-3 -> concurrency cap 1, route to fallback-model: gptq-4b. :lock:

deploy-bot: [automation] circuit breaker enabled on cluster api-prod-runtime-3 by sre-oncall at 1993204592.

maria: also recommend toggling buffer_reuse=false and lowering workspace_per_shard temporarily while we triage. force early kv eviction TTL to 30s for that service.

oliver: applying config patch to runtime (doing one-step to minimize churn):
```http
PATCH /v1/runtime/config
{
  "model_routing": {"fallback": "gptq-4b"},
  "allocator": {"workspace_multiplier": 0.7, "soft_reserve_mb": 256, "buffer_reuse": false},
  "kv": {"early_eviction_ttl_s": 30}
}
```

kai: we should also roll the kernel-selector heuristic back to the prior weight. selector_alpha was bumped to 0.8 last deploy; set to 0.6 to bias toward memory-sparing kernels for now.

oliver: updated selector_alpha -> 0.6, applying. starting perf snapshot collection now: /perf/snapshots/1993204567 (internal).

maria: good — once breaker is in place and buffer_reuse off, we should see OOMs stop. if they persist, run `runtimectl reclaim --aggressive` and add node to maintenance. add pprof & allocator dump to ticket.

raj: created INF-3124 (perf/regression) with pprof link and allocator dump, assigned to eng-runtime, tagging kernel-selector and allocator teams.

oliver: thanks — will follow up with a short postmortem tomorrow with root-cause hypothesis (likely workspace accounting mismatch with new kernel memory footprint + aggressive reuse).

maria: add checklist to postmortem: repro steps, bisect kernel commits, reproduce with high-concurrency job, stress kv cache eviction, validate buffer_reuse safety tests.

oliver: noted. saving logs & snapshot ids to INF-3124 and closing immediate incident. we can reopen if it recurs.
